title: A selector with no quote text resolves unanchored
rationale: A zero-length needle matches at every offset in every string. An engine that reports exact here will report exact for anything.

requirement.text: Failing that, the engine MUST present the annotation unanchored at document level ... with status unanchored. Annotations MUST NOT be silently discarded because anchoring failed.

input.content: The district is piloting local-first software this term.
